episodes.title: Pushing Off
episodes.summary: An epic party at the start of a new season brings new partnerships — and new rivalries — to the Russo Rink. But a moment on the ice changes everything.

episodes.title: Shoot the Duck
episodes.summary: Tensions flare at the annual bonfire when Elise invites the hockey team, Katya tries to take charge and Adriana shows up with an unexpected guest.

episodes.title: Inside Edge
episodes.summary: Adriana and Brayden begin their training — but to forge a connection, they have to build trust. Will sends the Russos on a surprise skating assignment.

episodes.title: Kiss and Cry
episodes.summary: The pressure's on when a magazine article puts Team Russo in the spotlight right before qualifiers. Elise opens up about her recovery.

episodes.title: Spiraling
episodes.summary: As pairs compete to win a spot at Worlds, Will sets his sights on a sponsorship gala where #Braydriana is the hottest couple on ice.

episodes.title: Crossovers
episodes.summary: Elise faces the consequences of her actions while Freddie handles problems on multiple fronts. Adriana and Brayden plot their next move.

episodes.title: Death Spiral
episodes.summary: With Team Russo poised to leave for Paris, Will puts his legacy on the line. A distraction on the ice ends in disaster. Maria longs for a normal life.

episodes.title: Medaling
episodes.summary: The World Championships kick off in the City of Love, and Adriana's heart is torn. She has feelings for Brayden and Freddie… but which romance is real?
